title: Newspaper: Law, Courts & Crime
sub: Court reports, police stories, and legal terms in everyday news.

cards.def:
The person who brings a case to court.
हिंदी: वादी
examples: Present: The plaintiff presents evidence first.
Past: The plaintiff sued for damages.
Future: The plaintiff will testify tomorrow.
Perfect: The plaintiff has withdrawn the case.

cards.def:
The person accused or sued in court.
हिंदी: प्रतिवादी
examples: Present: The defendant has the right to a lawyer.
Past: The defendant pleaded not guilty.
Future: The defendant will appear on Monday.
Perfect: The defendant has denied all charges.

cards.def:
A lawyer who presents the case against the accused.
हिंदी: अभियोजक
examples: Present: A prosecutor builds a case.
Past: The prosecutor presented new evidence.
Future: The prosecutor will call three witnesses.
Perfect: The prosecutor has filed charges.

cards.def:

हिंदी: बरी करना

Past: The judge acquitted the accused.
Future: The jury will acquit him.
Perfect: The court has acquitted all four men.

cards.def:

Past: The court convicted him of theft.
Future: Evidence will convict the suspect.
Perfect: He has been convicted twice.

cards.def:

Past: The court sentenced him to five years.
Future: The judge will sentence her on Friday.
Perfect: He has been sentenced to life.

cards.def:

Past: He appealed the verdict.
Future: Lawyers will appeal the ruling.
Perfect: The firm has appealed the fine.

cards.def:

cards.def:

Future: Police will arrest the leader.

cards.def:

Future: The suspect will be charged tonight.

Future: The suspect will remain in custody.

cards.def:

cards.def:

cards.def:
The person who commits a crime.

cards.def:

Future: The victim will receive compensation.
